profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Stride, Inc. (formerly K12)
profile.summary:
Currently, I am part of a team using JSF, PrimeFaces, JPA (EclipseLink) to build and maintain student enrollment system.

Past projects include: Drupal CMS multisite, CSS-based layout, old school layout. XML/XSLT. JSTL. Struts, Spring frameworks. Prototype/Scriptaculous libraries, including AJAX. MySQL. Maintenace of several Java-based sales training web applications. Google maps integration. BEA Weblogic platform using Java Page Flow.

positions.description: Architectural and technical guidance, Cross-team and cross-functional collaboration,

I led the development and deployment of a 15-site Drupal multisite platform, including custom module and theme development.

Build and maintain online learning applications using HTML, CSS, Java Page Flows, etc.
